failure_analysis.problem: A prevalidation design request is selected as validation solely because it contains before validation. The architect workflow designs candidate methods; running validation prematurely skips that required input artifact.
failure_analysis.suggestion: Treat planning/negated validation wording as architectural context; require positive implementation/pilot/evaluation intent for validate-method.

failure_analysis.problem: Consuming an existing canonical audit to repair a manuscript has no matching fixer rule and falls back to the modeler first. The modeler owns production evaluation/audit creation, not audit-consumption fixes.
failure_analysis.suggestion: Recognize a supplied/existing audit plus located manuscript discrepancies as a bounded fixer handoff; preserve the modeler exclusion for read/consume/copy.

failure_analysis.problem: Narrowing a thesis topic into a feasible new question falls back to a searchable evidence-question specialist. The Scholar design capability explicitly includes topic narrowing and feasibility; the evidence question skill instead prepares a searchable question.
failure_analysis.suggestion: Broaden design-question intent for topic narrowing/feasibility while retaining search-oriented PICO/synonym/query boundaries.
